chunks: Suleiman ibn Ahmad ibn Ayoob al-Lakhmy narrated that Ali ibn Abdul Aziz quoted Hijaj ibn al-Minhal, on the authority of Davood ibn Abil Forat al-Kindi, on the authority of Al-ba’e ibn Ahmar, on the authority of Akrama, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) drew four lines on the ground and said: 'The best women of Paradise are Mary, daughter of Imran; Khadijah, daughter of Khuwaylid; Fatimah, daughter of Muhammad; and Asia, daughter of Muzahim, the wife of Pharaoh.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the four best women in Paradise according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) draws four lines to designate the four preeminent women of Paradise: Maryam, Khadijah, Fatimah, and Asia. This tradition underscores the unique spiritual hierarchy of these figures, with Fatimah bint Muhammad serving as the central link between the prophetic lineage and the matriarchs of previous eras. The act of drawing lines emphasizes the distinct and elevated status of each woman, reflecting their individual roles in salvation history as recognized by Shia scholarship.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-23 Suleiman ibn Ahmad ibn Ayoob al-Lakhmy narrated that Ali ibn Abdul Aziz quoted Hijaj ibn al-Minhal, on the authority of Davood ibn Abil Forat al-Kindi, on the authority of Al-ba’e ibn Ahmar, on the authority of Akrama, on the authority of Ibn Abbas , “

God’s Prophet (MGB) drew four lines on the ground and said, ‘The four best women in Paradise are the following: Mary - the daughter of Imran; Khadijah - the daughter of Khuwaylid ; Fatimah - the daughter of Muhammad; and Asia - the daughter of Muzahim and the wife of Pharaoh.”
